name: General answer and structured-output evaluation
description: Compare answers with supplied references, check JSON object syntax, and summarize separately supplied schema-validation and human-review evidence.

prediction.answer.description: Model answer. NFC and whitespace normalization apply; case, punctuation, and articles remain significant.

reference.answer.description: Independent reference answer for the same held-out item. Do not fill this from the prediction.

prediction.structured_output.description: Serialized JSON object produced by the model. A parseable object is not proof that required fields or values are correct.

checks.output_schema_valid.description: Result imported from an independent validator against the task's explicit output schema; true means it passed. This engine does not run that schema validator.

human_review.support_score.description: Independent reference-based review, integer 0-4: 0 contradicts the reference or lacks support; 1 has major unsupported claims; 2 mixes supported claims with material gaps; 3 supports the central answer with only minor gaps; 4 fully supports a complete answer within the stated task scope. Synthetic fixture scores are illustrative, not actual expert reviews.

metadata.dataset_version.description: Optional immutable dataset/split version for traceability. Not required or verified by this scorer.

metadata.model_version.description: Optional model/checkpoint version that produced the predictions. Not required or verified by this scorer.

human_review.reviewer_id.description: Optional independent reviewer identifier. The scorer does not authenticate the reviewer or validate qualifications; synthetic examples do not identify a real reviewer.

human_review.rubric_version.description: Optional version of the human-review instructions used to assign ratings. The scorer does not verify adherence to that rubric.

checks.validator_version.description: Optional external validator version. Traceability only; not executed or verified here.

checks.schema_version.description: Optional task-specific output-schema version used by the external validator. This scorer does not inspect that schema.

metrics.name: Answer exact match
metrics.description: Fraction of evaluated answers identical to their references after NFC and whitespace normalization.
metrics.limitations: Case-sensitive surface agreement, not semantic correctness. Valid paraphrases can score zero; unlike official SQuAD normalization, punctuation and articles are retained.

metrics.name: Answer token F1
metrics.description: Per-item multiset F1 over whitespace-separated normalized tokens, averaged across evaluated items.
metrics.limitations: Lexical overlap can stay high when a crucial fact is wrong. This is not semantic similarity or the official SQuAD scorer.

metrics.name: JSON object syntax
metrics.description: Fraction of submitted structured-output strings that parse as strict JSON objects.
metrics.limitations: Checks JSON parsing and the top-level object type only; does not check an application schema, required fields, or factual content.

metrics.name: Imported output-schema pass rate
metrics.description: Fraction of independently supplied schema-validation flags that are true.
metrics.limitations: Trust depends on the external validator, its schema version, and its execution provenance. This engine only aggregates the provided flag.

metrics.name: Human-reviewed answer support
metrics.description: Mean independently reviewed support score normalized from 0-4 to 0-1.
metrics.limitations: This imports an independent review score; the engine neither performs the review nor verifies reviewer identity. Missing reviews are excluded and reduce coverage.

limitations: This is a reusable evaluation template, not an official benchmark scorer. All targets are unset; calibrate thresholds and minimum coverage on a representative held-out dataset. Scores are not automatically used as screening gates or RL rewards.
The JSON syntax metric and imported schema metric measure different properties. Do not describe parseable JSON as schema-valid.
The included cases and review annotations are synthetic; their scores demonstrate metric behavior, not model quality.
Unused metadata and review-provenance fields are optional traceability suggestions; their presence, authenticity, and types are not validated unless a metric references them.
